name: web-dark-features-bento-with-typography-aa-globe-and-security-locks
title: Black FEATURES bento: a serif Aa card, layouts bars, a globe with rings, a speed line, security locks and a mobile outline
whatItIs: A near-black page with a small caps 'FEATURES' label and rounded dark cards: a tall Typography card with a big white serif 'Aa', a Layouts card with three grey bars, a Global CDN card with a globe icon and concentric rings, a Speed card with a 'Load Time' bar, a wide Security First card with three lock tiles and a Mobile Ready card with a phone outline, each with a bold title and grey description.
whatItMeans: Minimal and demonstrative; each feature is shown by one tiny graphic.
techniques: Show each feature as one simple graphic.
Keep titles white and text grey.

vocabulary.definition: A tiny illustration of one capability.
A grid of dark rounded cards.
A card showing a type sample.
